verticalSponsorPages.title: PDF, Image, and QR SaaS Sponsorship
verticalSponsorPages.audience: Visitors fixing PDF size limits, converting images, making static QR codes, and choosing no-upload browser utilities.
verticalSponsorPages.sponsorFit: PDF APIs, image optimization tools, QR platforms, privacy-friendly document automation, browser utility products, and file-workflow SaaS.
verticalSponsorPages.pitch: Reach people who already have a file, upload, conversion, or QR job in progress.

verticalSponsorPages.title: Resume and Career Tool Sponsorship
verticalSponsorPages.audience: Job seekers creating resume PDFs, checking ATS keywords, fixing resume upload size limits, and preparing application documents.
verticalSponsorPages.sponsorFit: Resume builders, ATS tools, job boards, interview prep products, career coaching, and applicant-document utilities.
verticalSponsorPages.pitch: Reach visitors at the moment they are preparing or fixing job-application documents.

verticalSponsorPages.title: Classroom Printable Sponsorship
verticalSponsorPages.audience: Teachers, homeschool families, and parents making free printable learning, planning, and classroom-management PDFs.
verticalSponsorPages.sponsorFit: Teacher marketplaces, homeschool resources, classroom apps, learning printables, family routine products, and child-safe educational tools.
verticalSponsorPages.pitch: Reach classroom and homeschool visitors while keeping child-safety and ad-safety review strict.

verticalSponsorPages.title: Small Business Paperwork Sponsorship
verticalSponsorPages.audience: Freelancers, local sellers, home-service operators, and small teams creating simple business PDFs and print assets.
verticalSponsorPages.sponsorFit: Invoicing apps, bookkeeping tools, POS products, local marketing services, shipping tools, label systems, and small-business operations software.
verticalSponsorPages.pitch: Reach small-business visitors while they are making paperwork or local promotion files.

verticalSponsorPages.title: Local Marketing and QR Sponsorship

verticalSponsorPages.sponsorFit: QR platforms, review-request tools, local SEO products, print shops, signage services, event tools, and small-business marketing software.
verticalSponsorPages.pitch: Reach visitors making offline-to-online assets for local promotion.
